info.title: LifeLens AI
info.description: AI-powered personal life analytics API. Collects behavioral data, runs ML models, and generates actionable insights.

post.description: Register a new user account and return a JWT token.
Login with email and password using OAuth2 password flow.

get.description: Get the current authenticated user's profile.

delete.description:
P1: Permanently delete the authenticated user's account and ALL associated data.
This action is irreversible. Cascade deletion removes entries, insights, etc.

patch.description:
Change the authenticated user's password.
P7: Also increments token_version so all existing sessions are invalidated.

post.description:
Request a password reset token.
P6: Token is stored in Redis with 15-min TTL (falls back to in-memory if Redis down).
Dev mode: returns the token directly in the response body.
Production: would send an email instead.

Confirm a password reset using the token from forgot-password.
P6: Consumes the token from Redis (one-time use, 15-min expiry).
P7: Also bumps token_version to invalidate all existing sessions.

Batch-import daily entries from a CSV file.
Required columns: date, sleep_hours, sleep_quality, screen_time_hours,
                  steps, deep_work_hours, daily_spend
Optional columns: social_media_hours, active_minutes, tasks_completed,
                  mood_score, energy_level, notes, spend_category

Submit a new daily entry.
1. Creates entry in DB.
2. Synchronously computes features + Life Score (so dashboard renders immediately).
3. Fires async Celery task for full ML pipeline (clustering, RF, anomaly, insights).
